description: This PHP source file defines the Subscription controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles customer subscription-related functionalities such as listing subscriptions, viewing detailed subscription info, cancelling subscriptions, viewing history, and associated orders. The class methods coordinate access control, data retrieval via models, and rendering of views for subscription management in the user account section.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing user subscriptions, including listing, viewing details, cancelling, and viewing history and orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of user subscriptions with pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Shows detailed information about a specific subscription, including address, products, and history.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a specified subscription, updating its status.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a subscription's status changes.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history entries for a specific subscription.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Displays associated orders for a subscription.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of orders linked to a subscription.
